title: gentianella eichleri
intro: Gentianella eichleri, commonly known as Eichler's gentianella, is a species of flowering plant in the gentian family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. It is valued for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which provide therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of Gentianella eichleri include gentiopicroside, loganin, and swertiamarin, which are responsible for its health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
